scope: 隔離Docker、loopback実TLS HTTP/1.1、2 CPU/512MiB/cache256MiB、400Mbps帯域予算、fsync有効。投稿能力は1板16thread・80主体、専ブラ80%/Web20%、確認・確定の2 POSTにWebフォーム/CSRF/遷移先閲覧も含む。WAF検査有効、投稿全体1000要求/s・同時128、主体投稿10要求/s・burst30・同時8。通常client/global枠も隔離用。稼働側は変更なし。
implementation: 重複キー・Unicode・深さ検査と保存型の必須キー/null/数値検査を一回の走査へ統合。構文・UTF-8検査と最後のencoding/json.Unmarshalは維持。
既知structのキーをフィールド番号のbit集合で重複検査。256項目を超える型も拒否せず超過分だけmapを利用。RawMessage/map/独自復号器の内部は既存の汎用厳密走査を継続。
Input/Policyのcap_only省略時の補完を専用helperへ統合。通常入力のmap復号→全体JSON再符号化を除去し、補うのは既存のbool一項目だけ。HTML escape等で正規JSONが上限へ届き得る大きい入力は既存の正規化でMaxBytesを確認。
検証済み入力・metadataを別要求へ保持しない。採番・規制・署名・公開/ACKと耐久境界は維持。保存形式・JSON出力・圧縮器/設定・DAT206のidentityを変更しない。

scan_only.method: GOMAXPROCS=2、CPU quotaなし、500ms/条件、前後の順序を逆転し3回ずつ。合成投稿captureの主体鍵検証とmetadata読取り、または長文JSON復号。実I/O・HTTPなし。

"""収集待ちとJSON最適化を分け、同じCPU・メモリ枠で追加比較する。"""
import os,pathlib,json,subprocess,datetime
p=pathlib.Path('var/posting-scan-20261018')
env=os.environ|{'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'}
with (p/'build-deadline.log').open('w') as f:
 subprocess.run(['mise','exec','--','go','build','-overlay='+str(p/'deadline-overlay.json'),'-trimpath','-ldflags=-s -w','-o',str(p/'deadline-oimobbs'),'./cmd/oimobbs'],env=env|{'CGO_ENABLED':'0'},stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
context=p/'build-deadline';context.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(context/'oimobbs').write_bytes((p/'deadline-oimobbs').read_bytes());(context/'oimobbs').chmod(0o755)
(context/'Dockerfile').write_text('FROM oimobbs-performance:decode-throughput-runtime-20261017\nCOPY --chown=10001:10001 oimobbs /usr/local/bin/oimobbs\n')
with (p/'image-deadline.log').open('w') as f:subprocess.run(['docker','build','-t','oimobbs-performance:posting-scan-deadline-20261018',str(context)],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
manifest=[]
schedule=[(100,60,5,['baseline','deadline']),(100,60,6,['deadline','baseline'])]
for rate,seconds,pair,order in schedule:
 for variant in order:
  label=f'deadlinecheck-{variant}-{rate}-r{pair}';out=p/(label+'.json')
  cmd=['python3','scripts/probe-thread-resources.py','--image',f'oimobbs-performance:posting-scan-{variant}-20261018','--cpus','2','--memory','512m','--egress-bps','400000000','--waf','--waf-posting-rate','1000','--waf-posting-concurrent','128','--optional-log-stats','--posting-capacity-rate',str(rate),'--posting-capacity-seconds',str(seconds),'--posting-capacity-workers','80','--posting-capacity-threads','16','--output',str(out)]
  print('START',label,datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),flush=True)
  with (p/(label+'.log')).open('w') as f:result=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  item={'label':label,'variant':variant,'pair':pair,'rate':rate,'command':cmd,'exit_code':result.returncode}
  if out.exists():
   x=json.loads(out.read_text())
   item['summary']={'rps':x['completed_per_second'],'summary':x['summary'],'recovery':x['recovery'],'resources':x['resources'],'cpu_ms_per_main_success':x['resources']['cpu_cores_average']*x['duration_with_drain_seconds']*1000/x['summary']['success'],'wios_per_main_success':x['resources']['wios_delta']/x['summary']['success'],'integrity':x['integrity']['ok'],'optional_shutdown':x['optional_shutdown'],'stable':x['stable_at_tested_rate']}
  manifest.append(item)
  (p/'deadline-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(label,item.get('summary',result.returncode),flush=True)
  if result.returncode:raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
